memoryMetric: ProcessInfo.currentRss/maxRss; whole process, including native SQLite; not heap or allocated bytes
sizeMetric: UTF-8 JSON bytes; values/metadata projections are not an additive partition or a recoverable backup
metadataProjection: Global clock/HLC/delta sequence; per-CRDT sequences, MV contexts/version dots, retained change identity/dots/observations (including nested OR-Map changes); excludes domain values
timingScope: Fresh identical storage per run; setup/checks outside timers; engineStart includes restore/replay/save and SQLite reopen; pushPreparation includes read/filter/merge/markSent, excludes queue/network; query times are batches
mutationScope: Overwrite existing LWW field with the same value; still advances clock/ID; engineMutation starts after restoration and includes commit/adopt
queryScope: Engine count includes both peers; storage status selects one peer; valueAt selects one LWW string; these are distinct operations
sqliteFileScope: Main/WAL/SHM after close, preparation and one new mutation; no vacuum or reclaimable-space measurement; not the pre-operation JSON sizes
restorationScope: Canonical snapshot already contains pending effects; replay is intentionally idempotent; storage was closed/reopened, OS caches were not cleared
